_doc: D-PM-38, Subtasks S4 — which of my tasks the day planner may pack. A task is a candidate when it is mine, NEXT, open, not archived and has no block, AND it is not a parent with a step of mine that is itself NEXT: the NEXT steps are the units I schedule. A step in INBOX, SOMEDAY or WAITING cannot be scheduled, so it leaves its parent a candidate. Each case is a small tree of tasks. Defaults: mine true, state 'open', scheduled false, no parent, no stated disposition. 'state' is one of open, done (the lane is closed), backlog (an open backlog lane, so an unstated task reads SOMEDAY), trash (my overlay says TRASH) or archived. 'stated' is the disposition on my overlay (INBOX, SOMEDAY or WAITING). 'candidates' lists the keys the planner may pack. Readers: workbench/control_plane/src/app/calendar/components/shared.test.ts (the rail's plannerCandidates) and tests/live/live_ws39_subtask_planner.py (planning.LENS_SOURCE.candidates on Postgres).

cases.name: a task with no steps is a candidate
a parent with an open step of mine is not, and the step is
a done step leaves its parent a candidate
a step of somebody else leaves its parent a candidate
an archived step leaves its parent a candidate
a step I put in the trash leaves its parent a candidate
a scheduled step is not a candidate, and still keeps its parent out
a scheduled parent is not a candidate, and its step is
at depth two only the leaf is a candidate
my step under a parent of somebody else is a candidate
a step I filed as INBOX leaves its parent a candidate
a step I filed as SOMEDAY leaves its parent a candidate
a step I filed as WAITING leaves its parent a candidate
a step in a backlog lane reads SOMEDAY and leaves its parent a candidate
a step in my trash beside a NEXT step still keeps the parent out
